corrections: Parts.md has one row per part, 75 selected parts and 11 alternates or Q options, from hardware/research/round2/selection.json. A part that serves several functions has one row whose placements are the sum FU-2Q's P5 counts under shared-part stock. These are TPSI3052DWZR 28 (gate 700), IPT015N10N5ATMA1 20, SN74LVC1G04DBVR 5 (V326), MCP9808T-E/MS 5, 74LVC1G175GW,125 5, SN74AUP1G17DBVR 2 and INA228AIDGSR 2. A single run's verifier gated only part of each count, for example FU-2I's 20 port drivers (gate 500).

RP2354B and INA228AIDGSR carry the JLCPCB stock and presale of FU-2Q's P5 (2026-10-03T12:34Z). Their P4 records hold no stock reading (RP2354B) or a refuted one (INA228AIDGSR). TCND5000 has no P4 reading at all: its row carries P2's figures (FU-2E JLCPCB, T4 Digi-Key), each marked not verified.

LM4040AIM3-3.0/NOPB is labelled as the Q4 reference option, not chosen and not verified. FU-2C's datasheet verifier refuted it on V290's 52 ns share (FU-2C/013, adjudicator 014). Round 1's pages called it verified.

Five FU-2Q budgets carry their critic's corrections instead of P5's figures. Display supply: the allowed cable drop is 0.285 V with LM61460AFSQRJRRQ1 to 4.5 V, not 0.235 V. UART controllers, measurement: UART1_TX is also on GPIO 36, 38, 40 and 42. Cell rating: USB-C charge is 0.53C to 0.72C, not 0.56C. Pack protection: the post-trim edge is crossed at 8.2 mOhm on the 306.5 W basis, not 8.6 mOhm. 3.3 V rail at RPXFR 20 kOhm: 2.65 A and 88 %, not 2.78 A and 93 %. Each of these budgets is stated as not known, because the critic rejected it.
The receiver bus state machine assumption is stated with the P5 critic's correction to its supporting sentence (UART1_TX pin options). The critic upheld the assumption itself.

tools/jlc_stock.py: a held quantity under the need no longer stands in for stock. Such a row is checked by rule 4 like an unheld one and printed with a note. TPS55285VALR is held at 12 against a need of 20, and FU-2I's stock verifier checked it that way. Before this change the tool failed it as a rule-6 shortfall.

IOBoard.md states name the round 2 part on each line where round 2 replaced round 1's: BTS7004-1EPP becomes BSC014N04LSATMA1; TPS259474LRPWR becomes BUK7K6R8-40E,115 with TPSI3052DWZR and INA301A1IDGKR; TPS62933DRLR becomes LM61460AFSQRJRRQ1; BQ25713RSNR becomes BQ25723RSNR; MAX17320G22+ becomes BQ40Z80RSMR and BQ29209DRBR; WSBE8518L1000JKA2 becomes BAS-M-R0001-E-5.0 (V313); CD4082 becomes 74VHC21FT (V305); and the TCAN1472VDRQ1 external transceiver is added. The owner's later answers are cited on the lines touched: the DC input of 12 to 18 V (V319) and the 3.3 V a cell floor (V294).

Control.md, measurement bus B address row: the INA3221 addresses are written as 0x40, 0x41 and 0x42 instead of 0x40 to 0x42. tools/check_docs.py treats a paragraph that names 3 of the 4 settings.c k_ina_addr values as an incomplete enumeration.
The SN74LVC1G04DBVR placement disagreement of round 1 (R3 1, R4 2, booked at 3) is stated with V326's 5 a board, the owner's upper bound, which includes the external CAN standby inverter.

The 53 conflicts and gaps up to FU-2Q are each stated as not known on the group page of their first category, including those from T5 and FU-2P56. Where an owner answer followed an item (V321, V324 to V333), the answer is cited beside it. The item stays stated as not known.
